units.text: EXT. LIFEBOAT - OPEN SEA - DAWN
A battered orange lifeboat rides a long swell under a pearl sky.
Six figures huddle under a torn canopy.
Salt crusts every face.
SKIPPER BRODIE (50s, captain's cap, split lip) holds the tiller with both hands.
ADAIR (30s, ship's mate, ripped oilskin) sits opposite, passing a ration tin from hand to hand.
MEI (20s, stewardess, wrapped in a blanket) holds a thin plastic cup under a drip of rain from the canopy.
TOLLIVER (60s, first-class passenger, tattered dinner jacket) stares at the horizon with his hands between his knees.
SAMSON (40s, engineer, sunburned scalp) rows with a single splintered oar.
NAN (12, ship's boy, enormous lifejacket) sits at the bow, a rope around her wrist.
Biscuit.
units.name: ADAIR

units.text: He hands the tin to Mei.
She takes one, hands it on.
Tolliver takes one without looking.
Samson stops rowing, takes one, and chews loudly.
We'll hold this heading until noon.
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: And if the wind turns?
units.name: SAMSON

units.text: Then we turn with it.
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: Nan lifts her head.
She points at the horizon with her free hand.
A thin black smudge at the line of the sea.
Skipper.
units.name: NAN

units.text: I see it.
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: Smoke?
units.name: TOLLIVER

units.text: Or a cloud.
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: It's smoke.
units.name: SAMSON

units.text: It could be a trawler.
units.name: ADAIR

units.text: Or something burning.
units.name: MEI

units.text: Nobody speaks.
The lifeboat rocks.
Mei sets down her cup with care.
Tolliver straightens his dinner jacket.
Skipper, I have a flare in my pocket.
units.name: TOLLIVER

units.text: You what?
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: I had it all night. I did not wish to waste it.
units.name: TOLLIVER

units.text: Brodie stares at him.
Samson lets the oar slip from his hand and clatter in the bottom of the boat.
Adair closes his eyes and takes a long breath through his nose.
Sir, I'll take it from him.
units.name: ADAIR

units.text: No. Leave him his dignity.
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: Tolliver draws the flare from his pocket, unscrews the cap, and strikes it against the gunwale.
A red plume of smoke shoots up.
The lifeboat glows crimson.
For a moment nothing happens.
Then Nan begins to laugh, and Mei begins to cry, and Samson wraps an arm around the girl and presses her head against his shoulder.
Brodie lets the tiller go and sits back.
There she is.
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: On the horizon, the smudge grows a mast.
